<solution_file path="outputs/t07_query.sparql">
PREFIX wd: <https://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX wdt: <https://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX wikibase: <https://www.wikidata.org/ontology#>

SELECT ?poi ?poiLabel ?typeLabel ?coord
WHERE {
  ?poi wdt:P31 ?type ;
       wdt:P625 ?coord ;
       wdt:P131 wd:Q11959 .
  SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en" . }
  ?type rdfs:label ?typeLabel .
  FILTER( LANG(?typeLabel) = "en"
          && (?typeLabel IN ("art gallery","library","monument","museum","theatre building")) )
}
</solution_file>
